draft.subject: Quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge count — I can see the ticket is still open on our side, and I'm keeping an eye on it with Tariq until you confirm it's behaving.

Separately, you've got your first project in place and an invite out. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the next bit of value usually comes from getting real work into that project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Priya
